exercises.name: DB Bicep Curl
exercises.precautions: Elbows fixed at your sides - they do not move forward;Upper arms completely still - only forearms curl;Stand tall, no swinging from hips or back;Lower all the way to straight arms slowly
exercises.cues: Elbows fixed at your sides;Curl up without swinging;Lower slowly all the way

steps.dont: Elbows fixed at your sides - they do not move forward

exercises.name: Cable Bicep Curl

exercises.cues: Bar at thigh height to start;Curl without swinging;Lower slowly all the way

exercises.name: Incline DB Curl
exercises.precautions: Back and head rest on the incline bench the whole set;Upper arms hang vertical, slightly behind body - still;Elbows never come forward during the curl;Lower all the way until arms straighten fully
exercises.cues: Sit back on 45-degree bench;Curl both dumbbells up;Lower slowly into full stretch

steps.dont: Back and head rest on the incline bench the whole set

exercises.name: Machine Preacher Curl
exercises.precautions: Upper arms flat on the pad - armpits over the pad edge;Elbows in line with the machine pivot;Sit tall - no leaning or bouncing to cheat;Lower to near-straight arms under control
exercises.cues: Adjust seat so arms rest flat;Curl handle up smoothly;Lower slowly, feel the stretch

steps.do: Adjust seat so arms rest flat
steps.dont: Upper arms flat on the pad - armpits over the pad edge

exercises.name: Bicep Curl Machine
exercises.precautions: Adjust the seat so your upper arms rest fully on the pad;Elbows in line with the machine's pivot point;Curl without lifting your elbows off the pad;Lower slowly to straight arms - do not rest the stack between reps
exercises.cues: Arms flat on the pad;Curl handles up smoothly;Lower slowly to full stretch

steps.dont: Adjust the seat so your upper arms rest fully on the pad

exercises.name: Chin-Ups
exercises.precautions: Underhand grip, hands shoulder-width, bar fully secure;Start from a dead hang with shoulders engaged;Pull until your chin clears the bar - no swinging or kicking;Lower slowly all the way down
exercises.cues: Hang tall, grip tight;Pull your elbows down to your ribs;Lower under control

stretches.name: Doorway Bicep Stretch
stretches.precautions: Move gently until you feel a mild stretch - never force;Breathe slowly and relax into it - no bouncing;Keep posture tall and supported where you can
stretches.cues: Move gently to a mild stretch;Breathe slowly, never force it
